The person's zone was set to Europe/Zurich through POST /setup/profile. I walked in headless Chromium with scripts/bench/recorder.cjs. - Inbox (03): exactly one card, "Anthropic refused your API key", with "The key is not valid or was deleted. Save a new one in Settings; until then the work waits." and the link "Save a new key" to /setup. There was no Update.
- GET /notifications/recent had exactly one entry: request_blocking, the same title, the card's sentence with no "Answer it in the Inbox", and link /setup. There was no session_ended.

Walk B: --api-key ok --subscription (L4-creds-3, L4-creds-7, D5).
- I drafted a plan under key_only, switched to "Subscription first, ask before API key", and set limits.restingUntil to +1 h (09:26Z) as failure injection.
- Approve and start in the Inbox gave the ask card "Use your API key until 10:26?" in Zurich time. Its notification has the same title, the body says "until 10:26", and "Answer it in the Inbox." appears once. There was no session_ended for the waiting session.
- I answered Wait on the card in the UI. The session page (GET /sessions/:id and the screen), the Overview's Last result and the running bar now read "Waits until 10:26 (your subscription's limit); then your session goes on." There was no Inbox Update. Only the planning call reached the key: nothing moved after Wait.
- scripts/bench/restart-daemon.mjs, then the same reads: the same words.
- Walk C: chat while resting got "...at its limit until 10:26, so I have not answered. I can still add and change tasks." with Use API key and no Think it through. I changed the zone to America/New_York through /setup/profile with no restart: the chat reply, the running bar, the task rows and the ask card's Done line all said 04:26.
- Use API key variant (a new stop at 10:28): the work went on with the key and finished. The stopped session reads "Went on with your API key."

Walk D: under "then wait", with the subscription resting and no kept start, chat "start a session" was read back "Start a session on Map notes (up to CHF 5)?". After Yes it replied "Started a session ..." and the session ended at once to wait until 10:09. Nothing was spent. This is L4-creds-8 part 3, which the fixer listed in not_done.

The subscription's run paths cannot be walked on the bench (no Claude Code; config.anthropicApiBase is the real API). I checked the daemon log: no Claude Code process started. L4-creds-1, -2, -4, -5, -6, -9, -10, -11 and -13 were checked through their composed tests instead.

blocking.issue: L4-creds-8: chat's 'start a session' under a refused credential does not give the Start dialog's sentence once a session has met the refusal. That is the usual way a person finds a refusal: they press Start. Chat answers with a sentence that names no action and disagrees with the dialog on screen at the same moment.
blocking.evidence: Bench walk A (bench-api, --api-key refused, zone Europe/Zurich): Start session, then Start; the run meets the 401; the refused card is filed and the session ends to wait with a kept continuation. Chat 'start a session' then replies 'Your session of 09:23 goes on by itself once its Claude credential is back.' (no read-back). The Start dialog shows 'Nothing can run until you save a new API key in Settings.' with Start disabled. Files: /tmp/frbench/review-l4-cred-engine/steps/06-a-chat-start-refused-key.png, /tmp/frbench/review-l4-cred-engine/steps/08-a-start-dialog-after-refusal.png and /tmp/frbench/review-l4-cred-engine/evidence/walk-a.json (chatStart vs dialogBlocked). Cause: the chat startBlocked port passes the wait only when `w?.save && !w.startable && !w.kept`. The `!w.kept` exclusion was meant for a resting credential's kept 'Start at 15:40', but it also drops a refused credential's wait whenever a continuation is kept. session.start then falls through to the continuations' waiting sentence (compose.ts:4298, 'once its Claude credential is back'), which does not say to save a new key (design §5 rule 8). credential-chat-refused.test.ts only covers chat before any session has run, so the common path is untested. docs/user-guide.md and the ADR 0120 amendment (point 6) both state chat's start gets the dialog's sentence.
blocking.expected: Per the acceptance line 'Chat "start a session" gets the dialog's sentence with no read-back', a refused credential's chat start says 'Nothing can run until you save a new API key in Settings.' (or the sign-in form), whether or not a continuation or start is kept. Keep the `kept` exception only for a resting credential. Add the composed case: Start by POST /sessions, the run meets the refusal, then chat 'start a session'. Assert reply === start-check blocked.sentence and no pendingConfirmation.

non_blocking: L4-creds-7's reader has a latent limit. askFormAfterAnswer (packages/runtime/src/daemon/run-indicator.ts:99) calls `store.humanRequest.list({} as never, { limit: 500 })`, which returns the 500 oldest requests of every kind (default order is created_at ascending). On an install with more than 500 cards, a new ask card is never found, so the stale 'The card is in the Inbox.' comes back. Fix: filter by key, or order newest first.

L4-creds-8 part 3 (chat's start during a rest kept for the reset) and L4-creds-9 part 3 (the queued project's 'Goes on after ...' line) are in not_done with the reason 'Time', but neither is on the spec's cut line. Bench walk D shows the present behaviour: 'Start a session on Map notes (up to CHF 5)?', then 'Started a session ...', then the session ends at once to wait. Nothing moves or is spent, but the read-back does not say it waits until 10:09.
L4-creds-9's composed test has no compose-again round, which the spec asked for (validation rule 4). It is not listed in not_done.
L4-creds-6's test covers only the not-offered case. The acceptance's plan-form footer and ask line, and the ledger row kind subscription with planUsageShare on an answered chat, are not asserted.

The L4-creds-1 ask card title is the existing share form 'Use your API key until Tue 1 Dec?' (untilShort). The acceptance text says 'Use your API key until Tue 1 Dec, 01:00?'. The fixer kept askCardWords' existing form, as the triage told it to. The session lead should confirm which wording is wanted.
The real-daemon L4-creds-3 case sets process.env.TZ=UTC only. The spec asked for both TZ unset and TZ=Europe/Zurich runs.

ToldByCards.credential (runner.ts) matches an open refused or ask card by source_id only, not by the wait's stopKey. An old open ask card of another stop on the same source would also hide the wait line.

I did not re-run Playwright, test:integration or test:e2e; those come from the fixer's report. The UI changes are small (Conversation.tsx failed turn, PlanAllowanceSection change line) and their vitest cases pass.

Seen on the bench, other areas' wording: the running bar shows 'Nothing starts when Claude is back; its tasks wait for your Start.' beside 'waiting until 10:26, then it goes on' (the Cancel explanation reads like a contradiction). The session page header and log times are in the browser's zone (UTC here) while the waits say Zurich time. Both belong to l4-cred-screens and l4-starts-sessions.
